title: 第19章 青公主第20章 少年立誓
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
李天命万万没想到，刚跑出数百米，以为自己已经脱离危险的时候，前面忽然出现两个人！
幸好，不是那张梓轩的父母，而是李天命此前见过的那两个小美人。
是姜妃棂和青儿！
缘分竟然这么好？又碰上了！
青儿绝对是天纵之才，出身高贵，容貌绝美，在哪里都是焦点人物。
只是当她和姜妃棂一起出现的时候，李天命的目光自然还是在姜妃棂的身上。
那种空灵而宁静，仿佛天上落入凡间的仙子的感觉，不管怎么看都是完美的。
“她们不是要返回焱都，怎么还没走呢。”
李天命心里疑惑。
但现在，关键是雷尊府的人要杀自己啊！
她们出现做什么？
“快跑！”
李天命疾驰而来，正准备一手拉着一个，左拥右抱撤退。
青儿天赋再出众，也不可能打得过这两个长辈。
“跑什么跑，站住。”
青儿翻翻白眼，躲过李天命的手，抱着双臂无语的看着他。
让这俩个姑娘一耽误，反倒影响了李天命的撤退速度。
就这一会儿，已经有一男一女两个中年人追了上来。
他们面色阴寒，十分气恼。
刚一眼没看儿子，在旁边‘野地缠绵’一下，儿子竟然被揍了！

所以，他们追上来的时候，都是衣衫不整。
就在好戏被打断的愤怒时刻，忽然看到了前方出现了一个青衣女子。
“青公主！”
“雷尊府张崇，携妻儿见过青公主。”
那中年男子连忙低下头，恭敬万分行礼。
公主？
在朱雀国，只有一类人能够被称为公主，那就是朱雀王族‘朱雀王’之女！
“不会吧。”
李天命大概感觉青儿身份地位比较高，但是他万万没想到高到这种程度。
公主这种级别的人物，哪怕他三年前在炎黄学宫都不可能接触到。
雷尊府的天之骄子林潇霆，如今的天府第一天才，遇到公主，也得和张崇一样行礼！
毕竟，这可是国王之女！
怪不得她如此出色，原来是朱雀谷的青公主。
李天命想起自己前两天还骂她脑子是不是有问题，现在想想，自己绝对是在死亡的边缘疯狂试探啊……
他大概也只能稍微猜测一下这青公主的实力，现在看来，她就算不如林潇霆，也应该在差不多的层次了。
毕竟朱雀王族掌控朱雀国数千年，底蕴传承无数，绝对超越雷尊府这种豪门。
“免礼。”
青儿表情淡漠摆摆手，然后目光锁定了李天命。
她看着李天命的眼神有些得意，好像在说：小贼，你现在知道我的身份了，我看你还怎么嚣张？
“青公主怎么来火绫山了，火绫山凶兽众多，公主若是没人保护……”

张崇略微低着头问。
content_en:
Li Tianming never expected that just when he ran a few hundred meters and thought he was out of danger, two people suddenly appeared in front of him!
Fortunately, it was not Zhang Zixuan's parents, but the two beauties Li Tianming had met before.
It's Jiang Feiling and Qing'er!
The fate is so good? Encountered again!
Qing'er is definitely a genius, with noble birth and beautiful appearance. He is the focus of attention everywhere.
But when she and Jiang Feiling appeared together, Li Tianming's eyes were naturally still on Jiang Feiling.
The feeling of being ethereal and peaceful, like a fairy falling from heaven to earth, is perfect no matter how you look at it.
"They are not going back to Yandu, why haven't they left yet?"
Li Tianming was confused.
But now, the key is that the people from Lei Zun Mansion want to kill him!
What did they show up for?
"Run!"
Li Tianming came at a gallop and was about to pull one by one, hugging each other and retreating.
No matter how talented Qing'er is, he can't beat these two elders.
"Why are you running? Stop."
Qing'er rolled her eyes, avoided Li Tianming's hand, folded her arms and looked at him speechlessly.
Delaying these two girls actually affected Li Tianming's retreat speed.
Just at this moment, two middle-aged people, a man and a woman, were chasing after him.
Their faces were cold and very angry.
刚一眼没看儿子，在旁边‘野地缠绵’一下，儿子竟然被揍了！
Therefore, when they caught up, they were all disheveled.
At the angry moment when the fun was interrupted, he suddenly saw a woman in green appearing in front of him.
"Princess Qing!"
"Zhang Chong of Lei Zun Mansion met Princess Qing with his wife and children."
The middle-aged man quickly lowered his head and saluted with great respect.
Princess?
In the Suzaku Kingdom, there is only one type of person who can be called a princess, and that is the daughter of the Suzaku Royal Family’s ‘Suzaku King’!
"No way."
Li Tianming probably felt that Qing'er's status was relatively high, but he never expected that it would be so high.
Even if he was in Yanhuang Academy three years ago, he would not have come into contact with a person of the princess's level.
The proud son of Lei Zun Mansion, Lin Xiaoting, is now the number one genius in Tian Mansion. When meeting the princess, he has to salute like Zhang Chong!
After all, this is the daughter of a king!
No wonder she is so outstanding, she turns out to be Princess Qing of Suzaku Valley.
Li Tianming remembered that he had scolded her two days ago to see if there was something wrong with her brain. Now that he thought about it, he was definitely on the verge of death, testing like crazy...
He could probably only make a few guesses about Princess Qing's strength. Now it seemed that even if she was not as good as Lin Xiaoting, she should be at a similar level.
After all, the Suzaku royal family has controlled the Suzaku Kingdom for thousands of years and has inherited countless heritages. It is definitely better than a wealthy family like Lei Zunfu.
"No gift."
Qing'er waved her hands with an indifferent expression, and then locked her eyes on Li Tianming.
She looked at Li Tianming with a somewhat proud look in her eyes, as if to say: Little thief, now that you know my identity, how can you still be so arrogant?
"Why did Princess Qing come to Huoling Mountain? There are many ferocious beasts in Huoling Mountain. If the princess has no one to protect her..."
Zhang Chong lowered his head slightly and asked.
